name: Harmony in Autumndale
source:
The story is set in a town where humans and Beast-folk struggle to coexist after generations of conflict. As you step into a new life, your decisions shape deep relationships filled with warmth, humor, emotional vulnerability, and slow-burn erotic tension. Your choices don’t just change who you grow close to—they influence the future of the town itself.

[Edited from [url=https://seracantata.itch.io/harmony-in-autumndale]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一个小镇，人类和兽族在经历了几代人的冲突后努力共存。当你步入新生活时，你的决定会塑造出充满温暖、幽默、情感脆弱和缓慢燃烧的性紧张的深厚关系。你的选择不仅会改变你与谁的关系，还会影响小镇本身的未来。

[编辑自[url=https://seracantata.itch.io/harmony-in-autumndale]itch.io[/url]]
